topic.source_contract: source and receptor inventory, baseline sound, assessment method, effect levels, mitigation, consent, construction, commissioning and operational monitoring evidence

scope_guards: A noise contour is not treated as a measured façade level.
A desktop baseline is not treated as a representative site survey.
A mitigation concept is not treated as an installed acoustic treatment.
A planning condition is not treated as discharged.
Compliance at one receptor is not treated as compliance at all receptors.
A complaint-free period is not treated as measured acoustic compliance.
A permit application is not treated as an issued and complied-with permit.
No score or promotion is written without exact sources, receptors, method, consent, installation and monitored performance.
